summary: TAL Education Group filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended May 31, 2026. The filing reports net revenues of US$758.4 million (up 31.9%), income from operations of US$137.2 million, and net income attributable to TAL of US$408.0 million. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review, is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms or board recommendation. The event to watch is future operational performance and shareholder returns, but no special-situation angle exists.
